        public void solve(int testNumber, InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {
            int n = in.nextInt();
            String s = in.next();
            int longest = 0;
            long inside = 0;
            StringBuilder outside = new StringBuilder();
            boolean endedWithMatch = false;
            int i = 0;
            int len = s.length();
            while (i < len) {
                char c = s.charAt(i);
                if (c == '(') {

                i++;

                best = Math.max(best, word.length());
            }
            return best;
        }

        private long countInside(String inner) {

            for (String part : inner.split("_")) {
                if (!part.isEmpty()) {

                }
            }
            return count;
        }

        private StringTokenizer tokenizer;
        private BufferedReader reader;
